title: Guidelines for enterprise VPN security
leadParagraph: As more organizations move towards telecommuting (work from home) in an attempt to curtail the spread of COVID-19, the U.S. Cyber and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued guidelines for securing enterprise VPN systems. TT-CSIRT encourages all organizations to review the CISA Alert (AA20-073A) and take the necessary actions.
